full_judgment:
2. The facts, relevant for disposal of this petition, are that the present petitioner No.1 to 12 as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No.9 of 1999 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Naria, Shariatpur for permanent injunction after declaring their title. The fact of the case of the plaintiff-petitioner Nos. l to 12, inter alia, are that the suit land was recorded in Khatian No.1 in the name of government under the Police Station Naria, District Saharitpur of 62 number Patejangpur Mouza in C.S Plot No.564 corresponding to R.S. Plot Nos.997 and 979. 

 10. Defendant Nos.3, 4 and 6 contested the suit by filing three separate written statements contending, inter alia, that the suit is not maintainable and the same is barred by limitation. The case of defendant No.3 is that the Tashsilder most illegally gave settlement of 1.75 acres of land out of 2.11 acres of land bearing plot No.564 on condition that he would not change the character of the land. The land of C.S. plot No.564 corresponding to R.S. Khatian NoS.977-979 is Khal. The Assistant Commissioner (Land), Naria has recommended to cancel the settlement in question. The Government has taken a project under Food for Works program to re-excavate the Khal in question. The plaintiffs created some forged documents upon which the instant suit has been filed and as such, the suit is liable to be dismissed. 

 11. Defendant No.4 contested the suit filing a separate written statement stating, inter alia, that 2.11 acres of land of C.S. Plot No.564 corresponding to R.S. plot Nos. 977-979 is the land of Khas Khatian No.1 which has been recorded in the name of government during R.S. operation. The character of the land was shown as khal. Upon application a project was taken after forming a project committee and defendant No.4 was appointed as the president of the said committee. The project committee re-excavated the canal (Khal) in exchange for the wheat provided by the Government and cultivating fish in the said re-excavated Khal. 

 19. He also argued that the Government did not challenge the settlement cases and the kabuliyats thereunder and opened Khatians in the name of the plaintiffs and accepted rents from them as such the Government is stopped from challenging the right, title and possession of the plaintiffs. 

 23. It is admitted that suit land has been recorded in the name of Government as Khas land and classification of land has been shown as Khal (খাল) whereas the plaintiff claimed to have taken settlement of such land from the Government as Naal (খাল) land as it appears from their Kabuliyat and mutated Khatian.
